payload.title: File:Mosaic mackerel at Lochmaddy - geograph.org.uk - 1483360.jpg
payload.description_html: Mosaic mackerel at Lochmaddy. This mackerel in mosaic is part of the Road Ends Community Sculpture Project. Although it can be viewed from a wooden platform above the shoreline at Lochmaddy, it is impossible to gain a really good view except from a very low-flying helicopter!
